title: ByteSequenceFragmentV1
description: Proposed placement of one fragment within a parent ByteSequenceV1 fragmented representation. The fragment does not duplicate whole-sequence metadata: offset is relative to the parent, while content is a ByteSequenceV1 whose byteLength and digests describe only the fragment bytes. This schema is not yet canonical.

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset of the fragment within the parent logical byte sequence.

content.description: The byte sequence occupying this fragment. byteLength is required here and is the fragment length; digests, when present, are computed over only these fragment bytes. The fragment content may itself use any ByteSequenceV1 representation, including further fragmentation.
